289781.title: After Life
289781.description: A woman is pronounced dead after a horrific car accident. The funeral director is preparing her body for the funeral when she wakes up.

300173.title: Pumping Iron
300173.description: Arnold Schwarzenegger and Lou Ferrigno face off in a no-holds-barred competition for the title of Mr. Olympia in this critically-acclaimed film that made Schwarzenegger a household name.

301352.title: Rikki Tikki Tavi
301352.description: Narrated by Orson Welles, RIKKI-TIKKI-TAVI, follows a young mongoose who has been adopted by a British family. In order to protect them Rikki must battle two evil cobra snakes.

303161.title: Rugrats Go Wild
303161.description: The Rugrats family vacation takes an exotic detour when their boat capsizes and they become shipwrecked on a deserted tropical island.

307760.title: The Devil's Rejects
307760.description: The homicidal Firefly family goes on the run but, with a sheriff hot on their trail leads to an unforgettable, bloody showdown.

312419.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White And Blonde
312419.description: Elle Woods heads to D.C. to take matters into her own hands when she finds out Bruiser's relatives are being used as cosmetic test subjects.

342067.title: Zapped
342067.description: A teenager who struggles to adjust to her new stepfamily and school receives some help when a dog training app gives her the power to control boys.

364125.title: Hannibal
364125.description: Based on the best-selling novel by Thomas Harris, HANNIBAL continues the story begun in Silence of the Lambs. Seven years have passed since Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Anthony Hopkins) escaped from custody, seven years since FBI Agent Clarice Starling (Julianne Moore) interviewed him in a maximum security hospital for the criminally insane. The doctor is now at large in Europe, pursuing his own interests, savoring the scents, the essences of the unguarded world. But Starling has never forgotten her encounters with Dr. Lecter -- his seldom-used voice still haunts her dreams. Mason Verger remembers Dr. Lecter, too, and is obsessed with revenge. 364126.title: Thelma & Louise
364126.description: Two women embark on a road trip across the American southwest to escape the law, after one kills a man to save the other from a brutal attack.

372440.title: A Turtle's Tale: Sammy's Adventures
372440.description: Sammy the sea turtle and his friend, Ray, swim around the world enduring the challenges of the oceans in search of Shelly, the love of Sammy's life.

385507.title: Empire State
385507.description: When two friends attempt to rob an armored car depository containing millions, they must elude a veteran NYPD detective and angry local crime bosses.

415240.title: Gallowwalkers
415240.description: A cursed gunman, whose victims come back from the dead, recruits a young warrior to help in the fight against a gang of zombies.

418810.title: Don't Blink
418810.description: Ten people arrive at a secluded resort to find it deserted. Unable to leave, they investigate the mystery surrounding the abandoned lodge.

438033.title: The Host
438033.description: When a girl is snatched by a monster that emerges to wreak havoc on Seoul, her family sets out to locate the beast and bring her back home.

438117.title: Child's Play
438117.description: A dying serial killer uses voodoo to transfer his soul into a Chucky doll which winds up in the hands of a boy who may be the doll's next victim.

447841.title: Texas Killing Fields
447841.description: A pair of policemen are determined to hunt down a sadistic but elusive killer who has a knack for playing games and staying one step ahead of them.

448258.description: Sadistic maniacs, each with his or her own deadly expertise, torture and terrorize an unsuspecting group of friends who work at a local carnival.

448621.title: Welcome to Paradise
448621.description: An unorthodox preacher is exiled to a remote Texas outpost, where she and her son struggle to turn a barn into a church and a congregation toward God.

453645.title: How I Live Now
453645.description: An American teenager visits the English countryside and falls in love, but as war devours Europe, innocence ends, and her fight for survival begins.

457491.title: The Forgotten
457491.description: When a grieving mother is told by her psychiatrist that her son never existed, she and a man who had a similar experience try to prove their sanity.

457494.title: The Animal
457494.description: A meek file clerk dreams of becoming a cop but, when he is injured in an accident, a mad doctor uses animal parts to repair and transform him.

464209.title: Appaloosa
464209.description: Two gunmen track an escaped murderer to a lawless Western town, where they cross paths with a beautiful widow with a dangerous agenda.

464400.title: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
464400.description: When poachers grab Sammy and Ray and ship them toan aquarium, the turtles hatch a plan to bust out and find their little hatchlings, Ricky and Ella.

465366.title: Amusement
465366.description: Three women who were all childhood friends find themselves stalked by a serial killer with a personal hatred that makes their lives a nightmare.

465427.title: Rock Dog
465427.description: A Tibetan mastiff guards a quiet animal village where music is forbidden, but when a radio falls from the sky, a few guitar riffs electrify his life.

465497.title: Paddington
465497.description: A marmalade-loving bear upends life for a London family when they discover the whimsical creature at a railroad station and bring him home.

475631.title: Confined
475631.description: After moving to the suburbs, a troubled woman starts to suspect her new next-door neighbor is keeping someone locked in his basement.

475895.title: Creepshow 2
475895.description: Three gruesome tales of brutality, vengeance and the uncanny are unveiled in this this anthology horror movie based on the stories of Stephen King.

475906.title: Moving Mountains
475906.description: The true story of a heroic housewife and an untested lawyer portrays their fight against a powerful mining company that poisons their town’s water.

476279.title: The Reef
476279.description: Four friends face off with a bloodthirsty Great White shark when their yacht capsizes in the deadly waters of the Great Barrier Reef.

499444.title: Major League
499444.description: The hometown status of a baseball team is at risk as the new owner deliberately signs on has-been players to fail, until the team starts winning big.

502691.title: The Losers
502691.description: Based on the explosive DC Comic book, a group of elite U.S. black ops soldiers, betrayed by the government and left for dead, go on a suicide mission of revenge.

517827.title: Edge of Darkness
517827.description: A homicide detective, desperate to solve the murder of his daughter at his home, stumbles onto a larger thread of conspiracy, lies and deadly collusion.

527970.title: Blitz
527970.description: A tough cop and his sidekick, who faces ridicule from their homophobic squad, are dispatched to take down a serial killer who targets the police.

543161.title: Apocalypto
543161.description: A Mayan warrior braves the treacherous jungle to fight off attacking members of an opposing tribe in order to save his family.

549738.title: Taco Shop
549738.description: When a gourmet taco truck parks outside an upstart taco shop, owner Smokes and his plucky co-workers wage war to reclaim their taco territory.

555124.title: Bloomberg TV
555124.description: Bloomberg Television delivers business and markets news, data, analysis, and video to the world, featuring stories from Businessweek and Bloomberg News.

555126.title: Cheddar News
555126.description: Feed your curiosity about what's next. Watch Cheddar News for live news and original shows that explore the people, ideas and innovations that are shaping your world.

555127.title: LiveNOW from FOX
555127.description: Raw & unfiltered. Watch a non-stop stream of breaking news, live events and stories across the nation. Limited commentary. No opinion. Experience LiveNOW from FOX.

555129.title: Black News Channel
555129.description: The only 24/7 cable news network created “by people of color for people of color” to provide news and celebrate black lives, culture, and history.

555130.title: CBC
555130.description: CBC News is Canada’s source for breaking news that matters to you, delivering stories from your community, across the country, and around the world.

555382.title: FOX SOUL
555382.description: FOX SOUL celebrates Black culture and deals with real topics that impact the everyday lives of the Black community through frank, insightful dialogue.

556174.title: NBC News NOW
556174.description: NBC News NOW is a 24/7 streaming network featuring deep reporting, thoughtful storytelling, and live, breaking news from the global resources of NBC News.

557399.title: Forks Over Knives
557399.description: This acclaimed doc explores how a plant-based diet can control or reverse the afflictions of degenerative diseases by rejecting processed foods.

560641.title: 10 Shaolin Disciples
560641.description: When an assassin is sent by the Imperial Court to eliminate the Abbot of Shaolin, a warrior recruits nine other fighters to protect her community.

563162.title: Street Kings
563162.description: When evidence implicates a veteran cop in the execution of a fellow officer, he must go up against the culture he's been a part of his entire career.

563784.title: Black Mass
563784.description: Based on a true story, a notoriously violent mobster expands his considerable reach on the streets of Boston while also working directly with the FBI.

564227.title: Déjà Vu
564227.description: In the wake of a ferry explosion that killed hundreds, an ATF agent joins an investigation to find the bomber using untested surveillance technology.

567370.title: Exposure
567370.description: A couple in crisis retreat to a family cabin in the mountains to work it out, but ancient sins of those before them have set forth a monstrous evil.

571664.title: Bloomberg Quicktake
571664.description: Make sense of today’s biggest stories from the world’s largest newsroom. Watch live global news and go deeper with original shows on business, technology, politics, and culture.

574482.title: Unstoppable
574482.description: A train conductor and an engineer work to intercept another locomotive filled with deadly cargo before it derails straight into a populated area.

574500.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son
574500.description: The FBI’s top agent and his stepson go undercover as a sorority house mother and her niece to catch a killer at an all-female performing arts school.

575427.title: My Little Pony
575427.description: When a powerful enemy threatens the residents of Ponyville, it’s up to the adorable gang to save their homeland and prove that friendship always wins.

577043.title: Malicious
577043.description: As a young college professor and his pregnant wife prepare for the birth of their first child, a sinister supernatural force takes over their home.

577599.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
577599.description: A jealous wife kidnaps her cheating husband and his young secretary and holds them hostage in an isolated desert home, but her motive is not revenge.

578086.title: Newsy
578086.description: Newsy is a national news network that empowers you with the facts and context you need to make informed decisions. We bring you inspiring stories of people and places you won't find anywhere else — opinion-free, 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

578912.title: I, Robot
578912.description: Futuristic tale of a cop who mistrusts technology but has to team up with a smart engineered robot to see if a machine rebellion is in the works.

579151.title: The Hot Chick
579151.description: Hilarious tale of a mean girl teen who is cursed by being switched into the body of a 30-ish loser thief while trying to get back to her real life.

579288.title: The Nanny Diaries
579288.description: A struggling college graduate gets way more than she bargained for when she gets hired as a nanny for a neurotic and rich New York City client.

581117.title: Last Ride
581117.description: On the run after committing a violent crime, an ex-con takes his ten-year old son on a survival trek through the punishing Australian outback.

589037.title: Looney Tunes: Back in Action
589037.description: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and more of the Looney Tunes gang team up with an aspiring stunt man to track down an elusive and priceless diamond.

589079.title: Final Destination 5
589079.description: The chilling franchise continues, following students who survived a fatal bridge collapse, only to learn that death is still waiting for them.

589172.title: Secondhand Lions
589172.description: Set in the 1960s, this is the story of a 14-year-old’s amazing summer with his unusual uncles, as they tell him tales of their younger days.

589277.title: House of Wax
589277.description: A group of college kids on their way to a football game fall prey to murderous twin brothers, in an abandoned town that houses wax-coated corpses.

589884.title: Son of the Mask
589884.description: After an aspiring cartoonist’s infant shows incredible abilities and gains access to a powerful mask, he must take on the god Loki!

589889.title: The Little Vampire
589889.description: A den of kind but misunderstood Scottish vampires befriend a California boy, who helps them collect an amulet, which will turn them human again.

592656.title: Criminal
592656.description: In a desperate attempt to stop an international terrorist, the CIA implants the memories and skills of an elite agent into the mind of a criminal.

594626.title: First Daughter
594626.description: A young woman wants what all college freshmen want: independence from her parents. That is not easy, with a dad who is President of the United States.

597678.title: Today All Day
597678.description: Everything you love about TODAY, now all day. The latest news stories, tips and inspiration from your favorite TODAY anchors, all day long.

597681.title: USA Today
597681.description: From the nation’s news to heartwarming human moments, sports, and pop culture, stay connected to the world around you with USA TODAY.

599986.title: Made in America
599986.description: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV; and worse than that, he's white.

600026.title: Troy
600026.description: Brad Pitt stars in an epic tale of passion, heroism, betrayal and war that has been passed from generation to generation since the dawn of civilization--the story of the battle for Troy.  A thousand years before the time of Christ, Trojan prince Paris (Orlando Bloom) abducts the legendary Greek beauty Helen, queen of Sparta (Diane Kruger), starting a war led by heroes Achilles (Pitt) and Hector (Eric Bana) that devastates the ancient world.

600658.title: Hitman: Agent 47
600658.description: Rupert Friend stars in Hitman: Agent 47, a thrilling action-packed film based on the popular video game series. The product of a genetic experiment that gave him superior intelligence and superhuman abilities, 47 has become the perfect killing machine. Teaming up with a mysterious young woman, he uncovers secrets about his own origins and faces an epic battle with his deadliest foe.

603060.title: Falling for Destiny
603060.description: A woman who wants out of a stale relationship catches a glimpse of her future but questions her choice as she learns more about her new love interest.

604286.title: Killshot
604286.description: An experienced hitman and his unhinged young partner target a blue-collar couple who have entered Witness Protection after witnessing an extortion scam gone wrong. Based on the novel by Elmore Leonard.

604601.title: Rage
604601.description: A mild-mannered man and his traumatized wife seek revenge against the intruder who attacked them in their own home.

605219.title: Surf's Up
605219.description: A determined young penguin musters all of his courage to try and win a major surfing competition, but his opponents are even tougher than the waves.

605225.title: Jack and Jill
605225.description: The overbearing and needy twin sister of a successful family man comes to visit for Thanksgiving and manages to make every situation as awkward as possible.

605229.title: PRIDE + PREJUDICE + ZOMBIES
605229.description: Amidst juggling romance and family drama, a group of sisters also fight an army of zombies while protecting their homeland in 19th century England.

605423.title: Piranha 3DD
605423.description: Hot off their bloody rampage at Lake Victoria, the swarm of razor-toothed terrors swarm upstream to a popular water park where no one will be safe.

605644.title: Blind
605644.description: A police academy recruit goes blind and loses her brother in a car wreck only to later have to confront a killer whose hit-and-run case she witnessed.

605698.title: The Cat
605698.description: A young woman is murdered on an elevator, and the only witness is her cat. Her pet groomer brings the cat home, and wild, disturbing events ensue.

606516.title: RoboCop 3
606516.description: A heartless corporation kicks families out of their Motor City homes, inspiring RoboCop to bring his skills to a team of freedom fighters.

606562.title: Man on Fire
606562.description: A jaded former CIA operative accepts a job as a bodyguard for a nine-year-old girl. After she is kidnapped, he seeks violent revenge.

607839.title: The Wave (Dubbed)
607839.description: Tragedy looms over a gorgeous Norwegian town as a geologist tries to alert authorities to a seismic breakdown that soon causes a horrific tsunami.
